envelope.description: Introduce WorkItemKey and folderSegment in the path scheme

body.title: Introduce WorkItemKey and folderSegment in the path scheme
body.summary: Add WorkItemKey and folderSegment to path-scheme.ts, change resolveArtifactMdPath and resolveCompanionPath and the storage.ts path builders and pending.ts to take a key (story ordinal read through ArtifactIds.parse), and remove the re-exports of the identity constructor and type. Folder text stays exactly as today. id.ts keeps compiling for its other importers.
acceptanceChecks: paths for every artifact kind equal the paths built before the change
two artifacts of one Epic written on different days get the same segment
a story-scoped kind without a story throws InvalidArtifactKeyError
path-scheme and storage tests pass and the repository type-checks

tests.name: src/workflow/__tests__/path-scheme.test.ts: paths over a WorkItemKey equal the paths built before and a story-scoped kind without a story is rejected
src/workflow/__tests__/path-scheme.test.ts: two artifacts of one Epic written on different days land in the same folder
